description_en: Performs a paging query for the identifiers, deployment methods, and status summaries of custom code or image agents in a workspace
description_zh: 分页查询工作空间内自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的标识、部署方式和状态摘要
name: ListCustomAgents

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom code or image agent belongs
parameters.help_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent所属的工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is omitted or set to 0, the default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回条数，取值 0～100；省略或为 0 时默认 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The opaque token for querying the next page. Omit this parameter in the first request. For subsequent requests, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response as is and keep the same workspace. Do not construct the token manually
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的不透明令牌。首次请求省略，后续原样使用上一次响应的 nextToken，并保持相同工作空间。请勿自行构造
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The result code of the request. The value is SUCCESS when the request succeeds
code.description_zh: 请求结果码。成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request. The value is 200 when the request succeeds
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码。成功时为 200

items.description_en: The list of summaries for custom code or image agents on the current page. To query the complete configuration and the latest version execution results, call GetCustomAgent
items.description_zh: 当前页的自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent摘要列表。完整配置和最新版本执行结果请调用 GetCustomAgent 查询

agentId.description_en: The unique identifier of the custom code or image agent. You can obtain this ID from the response of CreateCustomAgent or ListCustomAgents
agentId.description_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent的唯一标识，可从 CreateCustomAgent 或 ListCustomAgents 的响应中获取

code.description_en: The code package deployment configuration. This parameter is mutually exclusive with container. The code package uses the ZIP or TAR.GZ format. Dependencies are packaged by the user. The platform does not install dependencies or perform online builds
code.description_zh: 代码包部署配置，与 container 互斥。代码包使用 ZIP 或 TAR.GZ 格式，依赖由用户打包，平台不安装依赖或在线构建

entrypoint.description_en: The startup command for the code package. This parameter is required in code package mode. The working directory is the extracted code root directory /code, such as python main.py. Quotes and escapes are supported. Environment variables, pipes, and logical operations are not automatically expanded. For complex commands, use a script within the package
entrypoint.description_zh: 代码包启动命令，代码包模式必填。工作目录为解压后的代码根目录 /code，例如 python main.py。支持引号和转义，不自动展开环境变量、管道或逻辑运算；复杂命令请使用包内脚本

languageRuntime.description_en: The identifier of the code runtime environment for the current saved configuration. The runtime image uses a saved snapshot. Adding a new version to the catalog does not automatically change the existing configuration
languageRuntime.description_zh: 当前已保存配置的代码运行环境标识。运行镜像使用已保存的快照，目录增加新版本不会自动改变现有配置

sourceUri.description_en: The fixed oss:// address of the platform code package referenced by the current saved configuration. This address does not include the signature parameters of the source HTTPS link. You can use this address to reuse an existing code package. To download the content, call GetAgentCodePackageDownloadUrl
sourceUri.description_zh: 当前已保存配置引用的平台固定代码包 oss:// 地址，不包含源 HTTPS 链接的签名参数。可用于复用已有代码包；下载内容请调用 GetAgentCodePackageDownloadUrl

entrypoint.description_en: The custom container startup command and parameters. If not specified, the default startup method of the image is used
entrypoint.description_zh: 自定义的容器启动命令及参数；未配置时使用镜像默认启动方式

instanceId.description_en: The ID of the ACR Enterprise instance
instanceId.title_en: ACR 企业版实例 ID。ACR 来源时必填；custom 来源省略，由后端按来源类型校验。
instanceId.title_zh: ACR 企业版实例 ID。ACR 来源时必填；custom 来源省略，由后端按来源类型校验。

namespace.title_en: ACR 命名空间。ACR 来源时必填；custom 来源省略，由后端按来源类型校验。
namespace.title_zh: ACR 命名空间。ACR 来源时必填；custom 来源省略，由后端按来源类型校验。

repo.description_en: The name of the ACR image repository
repo.title_en: ACR 镜像仓库名称。ACR 来源时必填；custom 来源省略，由后端按来源类型校验。
repo.title_zh: ACR 镜像仓库名称。ACR 来源时必填；custom 来源省略，由后端按来源类型校验。

tag.title_en: 镜像标签。ACR 来源时必填；custom 来源省略，由后端按来源类型校验。
tag.title_zh: 镜像标签。ACR 来源时必填；custom 来源省略，由后端按来源类型校验。

type.description_en:
The image source type. Valid values:
acr: An ACR image.
custom: A custom image source.
For the corresponding source configurations, refer to the descriptions of artifact.container and customImage
type.description_zh: 镜像来源类型：acr 表示 ACR 镜像，custom 表示自定义镜像来源；相应来源配置见 artifact.container 与 customImage 的说明

port.description_en: The listening port of the agent service

codePackageInfo.description_en: The current saved code package information
codePackageInfo.description_zh: 当前已保存代码包信息

crc64.description_en: The CRC64 value of the code package object

etag.description_en: The ETag of the code package object

fileName.description_en: The original code package file name

fileSize.description_en: The compressed size of the code package

format.description_en: The format of the code package

enumValueTitles.tar.gz: GZIP 压缩的 TAR 归档包

codePackageInfo.title_en: 当前已保存代码包信息
codePackageInfo.title_zh: 当前已保存代码包信息

createMode.description_en: The creation method of the agent. CUSTOM is returned for custom code or image agents
createMode.description_zh: 智能体创建方式。自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent返回 CUSTOM

createdAt.description_en: The time when the agent was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard. The trailing Z indicates the UTC time zone, and fractional seconds may be included
createdAt.description_zh: 智能体创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式，末尾 Z 表示 UTC 时区，可包含小数秒

deployType.description_en: The deployment method of the agent. MANAGED is returned for custom code or image agents that are deployed and managed by the platform
deployType.description_zh: 智能体部署方式。自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent由平台部署和管理，返回 MANAGED

description.description_en: The description of the agent purpose
description.example: 提供对话服务的自定义智能体

latestSpecVersion.description_en: The latest configuration version number. Updates with the same configuration may retain the original version number. This field does not indicate that the configuration has taken effect
latestSpecVersion.description_zh: 当前最新配置版本号。相同配置的更新可能保留原版本号；本字段不代表该配置已经生效

name.description_en: The name of the custom code or image agent
name.description_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent名称

protocol.description_en: The list of invocation protocol configurations for the agent
protocol.description_zh: 智能体的调用协议配置列表

items.description_en: An invocation protocol and its path and request header configurations
items.description_zh: 一种调用协议及其路径、请求头配置

additionalProperties.description_en: The string value of the protocol request header
additionalProperties.description_zh: 协议请求头的字符串值

headers.description_en: The request header configuration for the current protocol. The key is the header name and the value is a string
headers.description_zh: 当前协议的请求头配置，键为名称，值为字符串

paths.description_en: The list of API paths corresponding to the current protocol
paths.description_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径列表

items.description_en: An API path and its purpose description
items.description_zh: 一个接口路径及其用途说明

description.description_en: The purpose description of the current API path
description.description_zh: 当前接口路径的用途说明

name.description_en: The API path corresponding to the current protocol
name.description_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径

type.description_en:
The invocation protocol type. Valid values:
agui: The AG-UI protocol.
openai-chat-completion: The OpenAI Chat Completions compatible protocol.
custom: A custom protocol
type.description_zh: 调用协议类型。agui：AG-UI 协议；openai-chat-completion：OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容协议；custom：自定义协议

enumValueTitles.openai-chat-completion: OpenAI 对话补全兼容协议

protocol.title_en: 高代码智能体协议配置
protocol.title_zh: 高代码智能体协议配置

runtime.description_en: The compute specification of the agent. Valid values: INTERACTIVE, STANDARD, and HEAVY
runtime.description_zh: 智能体的计算规格，取值为 INTERACTIVE、STANDARD 或 HEAVY

status.description_en:
The overall status of the agent. Valid values:
Creating: The agent is being created.
Running: The agent is running.
Failed: The agent failed.
Updating: The agent is being updated.
Deleting: The agent is being deleted.
Deleted: The agent is deleted.
To query the execution progress of the latest configuration, call GetCustomAgent
status.description_zh: 智能体整体状态。Creating：创建中；Running：运行中；Failed：失败；Updating：更新中；Deleting：删除中；Deleted：已删除。最新配置执行进度请调用 GetCustomAgent 查询

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the agent was last updated. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard. The trailing Z indicates the UTC time zone, and fractional seconds may be included
updatedAt.description_zh: 智能体最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式，末尾 Z 表示 UTC 时区，可包含小数秒

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom code or image agent belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent所属的工作空间 ID

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询使用的每页最大返回数量

message.description_en: The description of the processing result for the request. The value is success when the request succeeds
message.description_zh: 本次请求的处理结果说明。成功时为 success

nextToken.description_en: The opaque token used to query the next page. An empty value indicates that no more pages exist. Pass this value as-is in subsequent requests
nextToken.description_zh: 查询下一页使用的不透明令牌。为空时表示没有下一页。请原样传入后续请求

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates success. A successful creation, update, or deletion does not mean that the background operation is complete
success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示处理成功；创建、更新或删除成功不代表后台操作已经完成

totalCount.description_en: The total number of custom code or image agents that match the query conditions in the specified workspace
totalCount.description_zh: 指定工作空间内符合查询条件的自定义代码 / 镜像 Agent总数
